info.title: SourceIntelligence MCP Server — Cross-Platform Service Installer
info.description: Cross-platform service installer for the SourceIntelligence MCP Server

options.name: --repo
options.description: Absolute path to the repository to index  [required for install]

options.name: --port
options.description: HTTP port the MCP server will listen on   [default: 5200]

options.name: --uninstall
options.description: Stop and remove the installed service

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
PREREQUISITES
The SourceIntelligence global tool must be installed before running the installer:
dotnet tool install -g SourceIntelligence
PLATFORMS
Windows  — Windows Service via sc.exe         (requires Administrator)
Linux    — systemd unit                        (system: requires root / user: no root)
macOS    — launchd LaunchAgent (~/.../LaunchAgents)  (user-level, no root needed)
